oldGroup.title: Production shift briefing
oldGroup.passage: Before we start today's shift, please check the revision number on your work instructions. The connector insertion step changed in revision C. Older copies must be returned to the line leader. The training session for this change will take place beside station three at eight fifteen. Do not begin assembly until you have attended the session and signed the training record. The material shortage reported yesterday has been resolved, so all required components are now available.
oldGroup.passageZh: 今天開班前，請先確認作業指導書的版本。連接器插入步驟在 C 版做了修改。舊版文件必須交回線長。這項變更的訓練會在八點十五分，於三號工作站旁進行。在參加訓練並簽署訓練紀錄前，請勿開始組裝。昨天回報的缺料已解決，所需零件現在都已備妥。

oldQuestions.prompt: What must employees do before assembly?
oldQuestions.promptZh: 員工組裝前必須做什麼？

options.text: Wait for missing components to arrive tomorrow.
options.whyZh: 缺料已解決，零件現在都有了。

options.text: Attend training and sign the record.
options.whyZh: 講者把完成這兩項列為開始組裝的前提。

options.text: Make copies of the old instructions.
options.whyZh: 舊版要交回，不是複印使用。
